In this experiment, you will investigate the cooling of hot water as cold water is added.
You are provided with a supply of hot water and a supply of cold water. Carry out the following
instructions, referring to Figs. 2.1 and 2.2.

parts.text:

parts.label: i
parts.text:
Pour approximately 150 cm3 of the hot water supplied into the empty beaker. Without
adding any cold water, place the thermometer in the beaker of hot water. When the
thermometer reading stops rising, measure the temperature θ of the water in the beaker.
In Table 2.1, record θ at V = 0 cm3. V is the total volume of cold water added.
